subject: English First Additional Language

source.subtopic: Week 2: /g/ (gap, gas, got, gun); differentiates ck and g; claps syllables in familiar words

show.line: Listen. g, g, goat. g, g, gap! Gap starts with g.

rounds.prompt: Say the sound with me. g, as in got!
Listen. g, a, s. What word is it?
Clap the word taxi. Ta, xi. How many claps?
Does it start with g or c? Sort the pictures.

hints: g comes from the back of your throat. g, g, g.
Clap for each part. Ta, xi.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! Listen. g, o, t.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! g, o, t makes got.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's do it together. g, o, t. Got!

parent_line: Can hear the g sound and blend words like gas, got and gap.
